description:
Use this when you need a deterministic workday offset and know the workweek variant. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the workweek or employer/shift scope is unknown.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Uzbekistan 2026 workdays under a required five-day or six-day schedule.
Example user requests: Add five five-day-workweek working days after 2026-12-28.
Inputs: start_date (date); workweek (integer); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-12-28","workweek":5,"working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, workweek, weekly_rest_model, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only when selected status is working
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/uzbekistan-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/uzbekistan-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

workweek.description: Required official schedule variant: 5 for Saturday-Sunday rest, or 6 for Sunday-only rest.

name: add_uzbekistan_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Nationwide 2026 statutory and PF-257 schedule scope.

day_type.description: Official weekend, statutory holiday, additional rest, transferred rest, special working day or regular workday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Whether the date is working under the selected official workweek variant.

substitute_day_policy.description: Published transfers only; no employer/shift inference.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Uzbekistan Working Days
